after_start.name: {name}
after_start.text: *After school. I decide to look around the campus. I still don't know the layout.*

after_start_2.name: {name}
after_start_2.text: *I walk down the hallway. My phone buzzes. — The group chat from my old school.*

after_kakao_1.name: {name}
after_kakao_1.text: *'Sojeong posted cherry blossom photos with her boyfriend lol'*

after_kakao_2.name: {name}
after_kakao_2.text: *I put my phone back in my pocket.*

after_kakao_4.name: {name}
after_kakao_4.text: *I'm fine. Really. It's already in the past. I never even confessed and it just ended. It's not lingering feelings — it's regret. — What if I had said something back then? Even if I'd been rejected, at least I wouldn't feel this unsettled.*

after_kakao_5.name: {name}
after_kakao_5.text: *At this school — I'll say what I want to say. This time.*

after_kakao_end.name: {name}
after_kakao_end.text: *I take out my phone again and leave the group chat. Done. — I belong to this school now.*

after_miss_dain_1.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_1.text: *Walking down the hallway when I hear heavy footsteps behind me.*

after_miss_dain_3.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_3.text: *I dodge to the side reflexively. Dain zooms past me. Running, then a sudden stop.*

after_miss_dain_5.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_5.text: Why are you sprinting in the hallway?

after_miss_dain_6.name: Dain
after_miss_dain_6.text: I'm late! Gotta get to the gym! — Oh, see you tomorrow! Transfer kid!

after_miss_dain_7.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_7.text: *She waves and runs off. Like a storm. We haven't even properly introduced ourselves and she's already this casual.*

after_miss_yuna_1.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_1.text: *Passing by the library when I notice a girl with red eyes walking while reading a book. The tattoos on her arms stand out — but the way she holds the book is surprisingly quiet.*

after_miss_yuna_4.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_4.text: *And she walks on. That's it. But — something about her stays in my mind.*

after_miss_seoyeon_1.name: {name}
after_miss_seoyeon_1.text: *On my way out, I run into Seoyeon in the hallway.*

after_miss_seoyeon_4.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_4.text: Lunch. I left the rooftop open. Making me wait — bold move for a transfer student.

after_miss_seoyeon_6.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_6.text: ...I went up for some air and the door happened to be open.

after_miss_seoyeon_7.name: {name}
after_miss_seoyeon_7.text: *She definitely waited. — I feel a little sorry, and oddly, a little amused.*

after_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *Knocks on the staffroom door. The homeroom teacher opens it.*

after_hidden_homeroom_3.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_3.text: *It's the homeroom teacher. Her cardigan is even more disheveled than before. Looks like the day took a toll on her.*

after_hidden_homeroom_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_4.text: You're not in trouble. — You're the transfer student, so. How are you settling in?

after_hidden_homeroom_choice.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_choice.text: *Sounds like a routine check-in, but her eyes are genuinely watching me.*
choices: I'm fine. It's a nice school, actually.

after_homeroom_ok.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok.text: Good to hear. — If anything comes up, stop by the faculty office. That's what I'm here for.

after_homeroom_ok_2.name: {name}
after_homeroom_ok_2.text: *Thought she was the distant type, but she actually looks out for people. — Or maybe it's just part of the job.*

after_homeroom_honest_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_1.text: Feeling overwhelmed is normal. It'd be weirder if you were chill on your first day at a new school.

after_homeroom_honest_2.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_2.text: Have you ever transferred schools, ma'am?

after_homeroom_honest_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_3.text: ...Something like that. I've been thrown into a new place out of nowhere before.

after_homeroom_honest_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_4.text: If it gets too rough, come to the faculty office. I can get you a coffee — wait, you're a student. Juice, then.

after_homeroom_honest_5.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_5.text: A teacher buying a student drinks?

after_homeroom_honest_choice2.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_choice2.text: *Professional concern. This person always hides what she feels behind her title.*
choices: If you're worried, you can just say you're worried
I'll look forward to that juice, ma'am

after_homeroom_honest_choice2a.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_choice2a.text: ...Fine, I'm worried. — Was it that obvious?

after_homeroom_honest_choice2b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_choice2b.text: *Stifles a laugh.* Don't get your hopes up. It's from the vending machine.

after_homeroom_honest_9.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_9.text: If you can't settle in, I'll come drag you back.

after_homeroom_honest_10.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_10.text: *She disappears down the hallway. Her long hair sways. — She called it professional concern, but her eyes told a different story.*

after_homeroom_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_freetalk.text: *Chatting with the homeroom teacher in the hallway.*
after_homeroom_freetalk.context: Day 1 after school. The homeroom teacher stopped the transfer student to check on them. The student was honest about feeling overwhelmed. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
after_homeroom_freetalk.personality: The homeroom teacher hides warmth behind dry humor and deadpan delivery. Early 30s female teacher with brown wavy long hair and beige cardigan. She wraps her feelings in words like "work" and "professional concern." Former aspiring novelist.

after_hidden_nurse_intro.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_intro.text: *Walking down the hallway when — my head gets a little dizzy. First-day nerves, probably.*

after_hidden_nurse_intro_2.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_intro_2.text: *There's a sign for the nurse's office on the wall. — Should I go in?*

after_hidden_nurse_choice.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_choice.text: *I've been meeting people nonstop since this morning.*

after_nurse_skip.name: {name}
after_nurse_skip.text: *I've wandered around enough today. Let's go home and rest.*

after_nurse_enter_1.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_1.text: *I open the nurse's office door. A faint smell of antiseptic. White curtains, a white bed, a small desk. A woman is sitting at the desk. White coat, a stethoscope around her neck. Ash-purple bob cut neatly styled, watching me over her glasses with her chin propped on one hand. She was reading something — and looks up.*

after_nurse_enter_4.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4.text: You're the transfer student, right? Already in the nurse's office on day one. Must be stressed out~

after_nurse_enter_5.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_5.text: *The nurse walks over. Her hand lands on my forehead.*

after_nurse_enter_6.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_6.text: No fever~... Might be low blood pressure though.

after_nurse_enter_7.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_7.text: No fever, but... you need to relax a bit. Here, lie down. Just ten minutes.

after_nurse_enter_choice.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_choice.text: *I lie down on the bed. Through the curtain, I can see the nurse's back.*
choices: You look more tired than I do, actually
This place is cozier than I expected

after_nurse_enter_choice_a.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_choice_a.text: *She pauses.* ...Sharp eyes. First time a patient's worried about the doctor.

after_nurse_enter_choice_b.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_choice_b.text: Right? That's the trap though — you'd better not become a regular here.

after_nurse_enter_8.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_8.text: You don't have to be formal here. The nurse's office is a chill zone. — That's kind of the whole point.

after_nurse_enter_9.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_9.text: *I sip some water and look around. A small potted plant in the corner.*

after_nurse_enter_10.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_10.text: Rosemary. — Been growing it since my hospital days. Ancient history~ I like it here. Everyone only comes in with minor scrapes.

after_nurse_enter_11.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11.text: Come by anytime~ The door's always open. But don't come too often. You'll make me worry.

after_nurse_enter_12.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_12.text: Next time you feel sick — ah, well, better if there's no next time.

after_nurse_freetalk.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_freetalk.text: *Chatting with the school nurse in the nurse's office.*
after_nurse_freetalk.context: Day 1 after school. The transfer student felt dizzy and visited the nurse's office. The nurse was playful but attentive. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
after_nurse_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is playful and flirtatious but hides genuine feelings behind jokes. Former hospital nurse who burned out. "Because I'm a teacher" is her shield — there's always a hidden emotion behind it.

after1_jealousy_seo_1.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_1.text: Hey, where'd you go during lunch? I went to the snack bar but you weren't there.

after1_jealousy_seo_2.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_2.text: *...What should I say. If I mention I was with Seoyeon, things might get weird.*

after1_jealousy_seo_3.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_3.text: ...The rooftop? Just the two of you?

after1_jealousy_seo_choice.name: {name}
choices: I ate on the rooftop with the president. (Honest)
I was just wandering around alone. (Lie)

after1_jealousy_seo_honest.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_honest.text: Yeah, she brought me there. Even had a packed lunch for two.

after1_jealousy_seo_honest_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_honest_2.text: ...I see? Could've told me, at least.

after1_jealousy_seo_lie.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_lie.text: Nah, I was just wandering around by myself.

after1_jealousy_seo_lie_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_lie_2.text: Really? Alone? — Well, makes sense, it's your first day!

after1_jealousy_seo_yuna.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_yuna.text: *A folded note falls out of my pocket. Yuna's handwriting.*

after1_jealousy_seo_yuna_2.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_yuna_2.text: *'I saw you on the rooftop at lunch. ...You looked close with the student council president.' — Three dots at the end. Words swallowed.*

after1_jealousy_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
after1_jealousy_dain_1.text: I saw you at the snack bar with Dain during lunch. You adapt fast.

after1_jealousy_dain_2.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_dain_2.text: *She's smiling. But her eyes aren't. Her fingers are tapping the clipboard.*

after1_jealousy_yuna_1.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_yuna_1.text: You went to the library at lunch? With Yuna?

after1_jealousy_yuna_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_yuna_2.text: ...She doesn't usually hang out with anyone, you know.

after_miss_dain_6_ins.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_6_ins.text: *She waves and runs off. — When she stopped short, she dragged her right leg slightly. Or did she? It was too fast to tell.*

after_miss_yuna_1_ins2.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_1_ins2.text: *I pick it up and hold it out. Yuna stops and takes the bookmark.*

after_hidden_homeroom_3_ins.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_3_ins.text: I was just... wandering around, it being the first day and all.

after_hidden_homeroom_3_ins2.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_3_ins2.text: Wandered all the way to the faculty office? That's unusual. — Come in for a sec.

after_homeroom_ok_ins.name: {name}
after_homeroom_ok_ins.text: *The teacher waves and heads toward the faculty office.*

after_homeroom_ok_2_ins.name: {name}
after_homeroom_ok_2_ins.text: *The teacher pauses for a moment. Leans against the hallway wall.*

after_homeroom_honest_3_ins.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_3_ins.text: *Something similar? — Does that mean she did something other than teaching before?*

after_homeroom_honest_6_ins.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_6_ins.text: *'Professional concern.' — She's the kind of person who wraps her care in job titles.*

after_homeroom_honest_choice2a_ins.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_choice2a_ins.text: *She admitted it honestly. — This person's facade comes off surprisingly fast.*

after_homeroom_honest_choice2b_ins.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_choice2b_ins.text: *She laughed. — That's the first time I've seen this person laugh at a joke.*

after_homeroom_honest_choice2b_ins2.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_choice2b_ins2.text: *The teacher heads toward the faculty office — then stops. Fidgets with something in her pocket. A pen, maybe?*

after_homeroom_honest_9_ins.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_9_ins.text: *Earlier in class she said 'I memorize names on the first try.' — Saying it twice means something.*

after_hidden_nurse_intro_ins.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_intro_ins.text: *There's a nurse's office sign. — Let's check it out.*

after_hidden_nurse_intro_ins2.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_intro_ins2.text: *I open the nurse's office door. A faint scent of antiseptic. White curtains, white beds, a small desk.*

after_nurse_enter_2_ins.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_2_ins.text: *Her tone is light. More like walking into a café than a clinic.*

after_nurse_enter_4_ins2.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4_ins2.text: Your uniform is stiff as a board. Smells like starch too. *Sniff sniff* Oh, there's cherry blossom scent mixed in. A romantic transfer student.

after_nurse_enter_4_ins3.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_4_ins3.text: *Is she perceptive, or just teasing? — Probably both.*

after_nurse_enter_4_ins4.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_4_ins4.text: *The nurse stands and walks over. Her movements are smooth. — Way beyond an ordinary school nurse's level. Movements ingrained in her body. The hands of someone who's done this hundreds of times.*

after_nurse_enter_6_ins.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_6_ins.text: You can tell blood pressure from touching someone's forehead?

after_nurse_enter_7_ins.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_7_ins.text: *I lie down on the bed. The ceiling is white.*

after_nurse_enter_7_ins2.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_7_ins2.text: *Pulling the curtain halfway* Want some water? Or something warm?

after_nurse_enter_8_ins2.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_8_ins2.text: *Handing over a cup of water* Right, I'm a teacher. ...I forget sometimes.

after_nurse_enter_8_ins3.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_8_ins3.text: *Forgets sometimes. — Sounds like a joke, but there's a sliver of truth in it.*

after_nurse_enter_9_ins2.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_9_ins2.text: Yeah, rosemary. — I've had it since my hospital days.

after_nurse_enter_9_ins4.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_9_ins4.text: *The nurse pauses for a moment. Then smiles.*

after_nurse_enter_10_ins.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_10_ins.text: *'Just minor injuries.' — There's relief in those words. It also means she's seen plenty of injuries that weren't minor.*

after_nurse_enter_10_ins3.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_10_ins3.text: Thank you. I feel a bit better.

after_nurse_enter_11_ins2.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_ins2.text: *Narrowing her eyes* When a patient keeps coming back, of course I worry. — Because I'm a teacher.

after_nurse_enter_11_ins3.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_11_ins3.text: *'Because I'm a teacher.' — That phrase is like a shield. She hides something behind the title of 'teacher.'*

after_nurse_enter_11_ins4.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_11_ins4.text: *The nurse pauses briefly. Her smile returns 0.3 seconds late.*

after_nurse_enter_11_ins5.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_ins5.text: ...You're a perceptive patient. And here I'm supposed to be the one worrying.

after_nurse_enter_11_ins6.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_11_ins6.text: *She looks surprised that a patient worried about her. — She's always been the one caring for others, never the one being cared for.*

after_nurse_enter_11_ins7.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_ins7.text: Right? It's nice here. — Quiet, and if you ignore the antiseptic smell, it's perfect.

after_nurse_enter_11_ins8.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_11_ins8.text: *Hearing it called cozy makes her eyes light up. — This space must be her sanctuary.*

after_nurse_enter_11_ins9.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_11_ins9.text: *I'm heading out of the nurse's office when — from behind me.*

after_nurse_enter_12_ins.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_12_ins.text: *A light laugh, but her eyes aren't laughing. — With this person, the line between joke and sincerity is always blurred.*

after_nurse_enter_12_ins2.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_12_ins2.text: *I've explored enough for today. Let's head home and rest.*
